spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (नालयति)
1 To shine.
2 To bind or confine.

m. (-लः)
1 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.)
2 The name of a king, son of NIṢADHA, and hero of several poetical works famous amongst the Hindus, especially the poem called Naiṣadha.
3 Another prince, the son of VĪ

RASENA.
4
A deified progenitor or

Pitṛdeva.
5

The name of a monkey chief.
6 A demon.
f. (-ली)
Red arsenick.
2 A perfume, commonly called by the same name of Nali.
n. (-लं)
1 The water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum.)
2 Smell, odour.
E.
नल to shine, affix अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला or ली-लं)
1 A hollow or tubular stalk, the stalk of the water lily, &c.
2 Any pipe or tube.
n. (-लं)
Yellow orpiment.
f. (-ली)
1 A stalk or culm.
2 An instrument for perforating an elephant's ear.
3 A period of time, a Ghari, twentyfour minutes.
4 Any tubular vessel of the body.
5 The pulse.
E.
णल to bind, affix ण, fem. affix टाप्, and ङीष्, &c.

n. (-कं)
A bone of either of the extremities, any long bone.
E.
नल a reed, and कन् affix of resemblance.

f. (-नी)
The knee cap or pan.
E.
नलक as above, and इनि affix; connecting the bones of the lower extremity.

m. (-लः)
The knee.
E.
नल a reed, or reed-like bone, and कील a pin or bolt.

m. (-रः)
The son of KUVERA.
E.
नल a reed, कूवेर a carriage yoke.

n. (-दं)
Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
f. (-दा)
1 The honey or nectar of a flower.
2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
नल here said to mean, fragrance, and द what gives.

f. (-का)
A sort of mat made with reeds, a coarse mat.
E.
नल a reed, and पट्ट a cloth, कन् affix of similitude.

m. (-नः)
A kind of sprat, or according to some, a shrimp or prawn.
E.
नल a reed, and मीन a fish; frequenting reedy spots.

f. (-का)
A perfume: see नली.
E.
नली, and कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A buffalo.
n. (-कं)
A lotus.
f. (-का)
1 A tubular stalk.
2 An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear.
3 A plant, commonly

Carmaghās.
4

A sort of potherb, (Hibiscus cannabinus.)
5 Any plant growing on a hollow stem, as Śaṇa, safflower, a mushroom, &c.
E.
नाली as above, and कन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 An arrow.
2 A dart, a javelin, a pike.
3 A lotus.
4 The fibrous stalk of the lotus.
n. (-कं)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
नाली a fibrous stalk, affix ठन्.

n. (-नं)
1 A lotus or water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nymphaea nelumbo.)
2

Water.
3

Indigo.
m. (-नः)
1 The Indian crane.
2 A small fruit, Karonda.
f. (-नी)
1 An assemblage of lotus flowers.
2 A place abounding in lotuses.
3 The flexible stalk of a water lily.
4 A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow.
5 The Ganges of heaven.
6 The fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoanut.
E.
नल to be bright, Uṇādi affix इनच्.

BRAHMĀ.
2

The fibres of the lotus stalk.
E.
नलिनी, and रुह what grows.

m. (-यः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
नलिने in a lotus, and शय who sleeps.

m. (-ल्वः)
A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred cubits.
E.
नल to be as a reed in length, and व aff.

f. (-गा)
The orange tree.
E.
नल्व as above, वर्त्म a road, and ग what goes.

f. (-लिः)
Any tubular vessel of the body.
E.
ल interchanged with डः see नाडि.

m. (-रः)
The cocoanut.
E.
नल to bind, affix इन, नालि a leaf, &c. क air, wind, and इर what goes; fluttering in the wind.

m. (-ङ्घः)
A raven or the carrion crow.
E.
नालि a tube, and जङ्घा the leg.

f. (-ता)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)

f. (-नी)
A multitude of lotus flowers.
E.
नालीक, and इनि aff.

m. (-णः)
A fistulous or sinous sore: see नाडीव्रण, ल and ड being interchanged.
